newsitem.title: USA: Publisher Larry Flynt hands out Hustler in Ohio.
newsitem.headline: Publisher Larry Flynt hands out Hustler in Ohio.

text.p: A boisterous crowd snatched up free copies of Hustler magazine on Wednesday passed out by publisher Larry Flynt, who flouted a local ban on the magazine and dared authorities to arrest him.
"If they're smart, they'll just ignore me," the wheelchair-bound publisher said.
Police on foot and on horseback heeded Flynt's advice, watching warily as magazine-seekers enveloped Flynt and several aides handing out hundreds of copies of the magazine's August issue.
Flynt was depicted as a reluctant free-speech pioneer in the recent movie "The People vs. Larry Flynt," which prominently featured his 1977 Cincinnati trial for pandering.

Spearheaded by Hamilton County Sheriff Simon Leis, local authorities have maintained a 20-year ban against the sale of Hustler, which they claim contains lurid acts of sexual perversion. Cincinnati storeowners tend not to challenge the de facto ban.
Flynt said he viewed Wednesday's stunt as a confrontation with Leis, his longtime nemesis in Cincinnati, which Flynt considers his hometown and where he launched Hustler in the 1970s.

It was Leis who orchestrated Flynt's arrest on pandering obscenity charges in 1977 when Leis was the Hamilton County prosecutor. Flynt was convicted and spent six days in jail before he was released on bond. The conviction was later overturned on appeal.
"This is America. I should be able to buy what I want," said Mike Rollison, one of those grabbing for a free magazine.
The Cincinnati Enquirer advised in an editorial published on Wednesday against any legal confrontation with Flynt.

"But no matter what happens, the masochists among us will wring their hands in anguish over the way Mr. Flynt's latest publicity scam will underline Cincinnati's national reputation as Prude City, U.S. Capital of Family Values," the editorial said.
"Don't lose any sleep over it, Cincinnati. Having a national reputation for being a place that has no patience for the sorry likes of Larry Flynt is nothing to be ashamed of."
